//: Type errors the verification scripts are allowed to carry, per file. This is a ratchet: a file may not grow, no new file may appear, and fixing errors means lowering the number here. The budget is now EMPTY — the ratchet has become a hard gate, so any type error in scripts/ fails the build. Do not add entries; fix the error.
why: src/ is typechecked by `tsc -p tsconfig.json`; scripts/ was never included, so 43 verification suites grew 108 type errors unnoticed. 0.7.13 made them visible (108 → 25) and 0.7.14 burned the rest down to zero. The 25 that were left were not cosmetic: `debug-completion.ts` called `diagnose(code)` against a `diagnose(languageId, code)` signature, so it passed the source text as a language id; `verify-plugins.ts` computed `memoryBytes` from a `runnerBytes` field that no longer existed; `verify-baseline.ts` built `PerfEvent`s with no `category` and a `PerfMetric` with no `unit`; `verify-extensions.ts` declared a numeric command result as `string` and compared it to `6765`. Every one of those ran without complaint because types are erased.
